svg.title: RcppEnsmallen
svg.desc: A cool near-white hexagon holds a loss basin drawn as seven nested contour rings in cool blue-grey, thickening steadily inward along a valley that runs from the upper left down to a single amber minimum, a filled disc seated in a deep navy socket low and right of centre. A deep navy optimiser trace zigzags down that valley in six straight strides, each shorter and narrower than the last, dropping an open navy ring at every iterate before it lands on the minimum, and across the bottom the wordmark reads RcppEnsmallen, Rcpp in muted blue-grey and Ensmallen in bold deep navy, inside a deep navy hexagon outline.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
